page_title: We're very sorry, but your browser is not supported!

summary.name: Slack
summary.one_liner: Slack is a team messaging and collaboration platform; this page is a shared workspace invite link that shows a browser-unsupported error and offers desktop and mobile app downloads.
use_cases: join a team workspace via invite link
summary.what_it_does: The page is a Slack shared invite link for the camel-kwr1314 workspace, but the browser shown is not supported, so it asks the user to upgrade or use an app instead. It lists desktop app downloads for Mac (v4.53.269), Windows (v4.53.269) and Linux (v4.52.182), with links to system requirements, and mobile app links for iOS and Android. The rest of the page is navigation and footer links to product, pricing, support, API, and legal pages. No features are described in detail on this page.
notable: Shared invite link for a specific Slack workspace
Desktop apps for Mac, Windows and Linux
Mobile apps for iOS and Android
caveats: Page shows an unsupported-browser error, so the invite must be opened in a supported browser or app
Pricing is not stated on this page
